newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent rallies with gasoline, Amoco buying.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent rallies with gasoline, Amoco buying.

text.p: IPE Brent crude oil futures reversed their early slide on news that Amoco was buying gasoline heavily in the U.S. Gulf coast, a possible sign of problems at its huge Texas refinery, brokers said.
Having touched a low of $24.02, December Brent jumped nearly 50 cents to $24.51 per barrel by 1636 GMT, 29 cents above Friday's settlement.
"Gasoline and heating oil are leading the way up and Brent is following," a broker said.
U.S. traders said Amoco was buying gasoline in the U.S. Gulf amid talk of problems at its Texas refinery.
Traders said Amoco had bought as much as 300,000 barrels of gasoline on Monday morning, in addition to similar volumes on Friday and Thursday last week.
NYMEX unleaded futures stood 1.3 cents higher at 71.40 cents per barrel.
November IPE gas oil futures followed the Brent market up, gaining $2.75 to $227.00 per tonne.
But volume in gas oil was thin and the December crack spread with Brent was steady at $5.30 per barrel.
